title: DAO vectors falsely identify production Schnorr as their signature oracle
description: generate_dao_origin_signature.py now correctly imports test/vectors/reference_schnorr48.py, but emitted oracle_provenance.signature_generation still says python/src/lichen/crypto/schnorr48.py. This false metadata defeats the purpose of the independent-oracle audit and misleads cross-implementation consumers. Point provenance to the independent PyNaCl-backed reference module, regenerate deterministically, and coordinate the metadata-only hash change.
